perspective: The south garden view (school, 2024 file) puts the two halls either side of the entrance path. The two-storey link is visible at the back. The garden faces roughly SSE. The right hall is the east house. Its southwest corner sits at the east side of that passage.
roof_shapes: Distinct hipped roof ridges and front pediments, image in two-roofs.jpg. A plain elongated roof lies farther north on 2685.
photographic_frame: Use only the first full bay between the continuous decorated pier to the left and the first cylindrical column to its right. Lower balustrade, middle and upper balustrades, lintels and roof edge are visible in both documents. The central connecting halls and west house remain beyond the western pier.
